sn16.13:1.4: Asked by Bhaddāli at [mn65:29.1](). There, the Buddha said, as he did to Sāriputta at [pli-tv-bu-vb-pj1:3.4.6](), that decline comes from defiling influences in the Saṅgha.
sn16.13:1.8: In an age of commercialized spirituality, AI, the proliferation of sects and gurus, and the collapse of moral authority of traditional Saṅgha under the weight of institutional corruption, this seems relevant.
